KAI Ambient Normal and Vinyl: shared playback/record renderer, remembered presentation, responsive landscape artwork and lyrics, compact in-screen switching and inactivity-aware controls
KAI finishing details: refined physical vinyl grooves, edge, spindle and tonearm; original integrated K/music-note adaptive and monochrome branding; native splash and lifecycle-aware spiral loading
KAI Home and Library: consistent editorial spacing, compact preserved collection shortcuts, stable real shelves and explicit initial/pagination/retry feedback
KAI liquid bottom navigation: fixed five-cell geometry, continuous finger-tracked indicator, release-only routing, actual frosted backdrop surfaces and a matching refined mini-player

KAI premium redesign: shared dark plum/rose and warm light palettes, Plus Jakarta Sans typography, reusable headings, artwork cards and grouped settings across Home, Library and Search
KAI About and Welcome: real app version/channel, shared branding and centralized validated public link configuration with disabled Coming soon placeholders
KAI player refinement: contextual header, responsive Vinyl/Normal/Lyrics selector, readable lyrics, restrained transport feedback and thin lifecycle-aware local/Cast mini-player progress
Kai: rebrand the app name, localized display text, default launcher icon, generic app marks, widget names and share output while retaining compatible internal identifiers

Local Taste Engine: Offline, account-free algorithmic recommendation engine with skip tracking and taste mix generation
Local Taste Engine (Slice 2): Multi-source Last.fm recommendation pipeline (similar tracks, similar artists, top genres) with 1-hour taste snapshot caching and additive scoring bonuses
Local Taste Engine (Slice 3): Genre awareness with additive scoring bonus (+1.0), YouTube taste signals extraction, cross-screen generation status synchronization, and 'From Taste' quick action

Music Flow: optional full-screen vertical swipe discovery (Home shortcut) that plays personalized songs through the existing player, with like/playlist/share/lyrics actions, Not interested / Less like this feedback, Restore previous queue, offline downloaded-song fallback and settings under Settings â†’ Music Flow

Android Auto: optional autoplay of the restored queue on automotive connect (Settings â†’ Player, default off) and Home browse node with YouTube Home sections, suggested and recent content alongside local library
bug_fixes: Release review: preserve complete modified source and notices, replace inherited restricted font with official OFL edition, remove inherited Last.fm credentials and prepare signature-checked draft release/source/checksum workflow with honest stable/preview download selection
Lyrics: replace the frozen independent playing latch/animation-frame clock with shared session state and live position samples, preserving paused seeks and receiver timing
Lyrics Refetch: bypass stale in-memory results, fetch outside the Room query executor and retain saved text on network failures or concurrent edits
Lyrics: keep the audio timeline and auto-follow active when the visible player rests just short of its exact expanded anchor after a drag or resize; stop presentation work while hidden

Lyrics: preserve joined syllables and Hindi text, parse enhanced whole-second/tenth timestamps and gaps correctly, prefer genuinely timed YouLyPlus mirrors and reject incompatible duration/edit metadata; remove continuous line-only glow text rebuilding

KAI 1.4.6 (167): remove inherited Echo update checks, startup popups, notifications, remote changelogs and leaked updater observer; cancel only retired update work/alerts and show Coming soon on both update routes
Public KAI page: keep only the app description, one download button and a vinyl screenshot; distribute the complete project source separately as a release ZIP
Navigation: immediate root switching and independent tap feedback, preserving saved destination state and stopping hidden full-player transport polling
Lyrics: detect untimed zero/constant timestamps, preserve real millisecond precision and blank gaps, remove the hidden lead, and prevent programmatic scrolling from disabling auto-follow
Player: clip the available lyrics viewport separately from song information and bounded controls, including compact heights
Lyrics fetching: shared bounded cache/in-flight requests, enabled provider order, cautious timed upgrades and title/artist/duration matching
Liquid navigation: retain the release spring when its destination is confirmed to prevent a second settle and visible hitch
Home: retain cached music during refresh, serialize requests, clear loading flags reliably, avoid idle pagination skeletons and stabilize section ordering/identity
Ambient and motion: preserve playback/queue and saved presentation, restore window/orientation state, route Cast/guest controls correctly and stop hidden/background/reduced-motion decoration
Navigation: keep Recognition's bar and mini-player stable, synchronize Search/detail/Back selections with navigation-entry ownership, avoid duplicate root navigation and reserve complete dock insets
Lyrics: validate real word timestamps and original grapheme-safe text spans, use whole-line fallback for untimed/romanized text, follow local/Cast paused seeks and stop hidden/paused frame work

KAI accessibility and performance: light-theme lyric/transport contrast, compact player spacing, larger labeled touch targets, stable search result keys, removed artificial search/lyrics delays and reduced-motion feedback
KAI link cleanup: remove inherited developer/payment destinations from public UI, route unconfigured update notifications to About and omit invalid Discord presence buttons
Build: declare compileSdkMinor = 0 alongside API 37 so AGP resolves the installed Android SDK 37.0 platform

Stats: fix NullPointerException crash when opening Stats by making SongWithStats thumbnailUrl and play counts safely nullable, removing unsafe forced unwraps, and guarding date sequence boundaries (#646)

Playback: fix custom addon (BitChord) queue repeating the first track audio when advancing, caused by stale trackedMediaItem metadata and loose title-only matching; resolve per-mediaId metadata with strict title+artist+duration match and addon-aware preload
Android Auto: fix Home shelves rendering without artwork and shuffle-led shelves ('Casuale') browsing empty, by falling back to the first item thumbnail and mapping musicShuffleRenderer
Android Auto: embed browse artwork in the media item so covers load without the app in the foreground, and stop replacing failed artwork lookups with a blank bitmap
Prevent missing song-ID map crashes in Quick Picks and Forgotten Favorites by keeping randomized Room relation queries stable across statement resets

Fix artist names containing & showing as "amp;" (e.g. "Sabin Rai, amp; The Pharaoh") by decoding HTML entities and dropping orphan entity fragments from YouTube Music API display text at the :innertube parse boundary
Music Flow: show the translucent play icon on album artwork only while paused, hide it during playback, and keep direct tap playback control
Music Flow: synchronize lyrics to playback and saved timing offsets, follow paused seeks and song changes, preserve instrumental gaps, and animate line changes with a smooth slide and fade
Music Flow: automatically scroll long song titles and artist names
Lyrics: time out stalled providers so other lyrics sources can be tried
Android Auto: deliver artwork as signed content URIs, cache cluster covers, stabilize Home shelves across reconnects, and fall back to hqdefault when maxresdefault 404s (#677)
Playback: fix downloaded track playback mismatch when filtering explicit/video songs, and recognize completed offline downloads when contentLength is unset (#666, #674)
Playlists: allow removing duplicate songs from a playlist directly from the 'Add to playlist' dialog and fix premature dialog dismissal (#655, #675)
